hints.title: Triplet Algebraic Symmetry
hints.text: Notice the symmetric structure of ((nums[i] | nums[j]) & nums[k]) over all index triplets.

hints.title: Symmetric Term Cancellation
hints.text: Whenever index i differs from j, swapping i and j produces identical terms that cancel each other out under bitwise exclusive-or.

hints.title: Total Reduction to Array XOR
hints.text: When i equals j, the expression reduces to nums[i] & nums[k]. Any pair where i differs from k appears twice and cancels, leaving solely the bitwise exclusive-or of all elements.

hints.title: Linear XOR Reduction Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass accumulating bitwise exclusive-or.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all n^3 triplets takes cubic O(n^3) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies algebraic cancellation symmetry to reduce the cubic expression to overall array xor sum.
